Recorded claim:
Repair the interaction rather than adding arbitrary waits: `await dialog.show()` for geometry-dependent tests, click the visible `label[for="maybe"]`, and synchronize `files/calendarDialog.xhtml` with `calendarDialogAcceptanceTemplate.inc.xhtml`. Attendee rows render through `scheduler.postTask`, so wait with `TestUtils.waitForCondition()` before reading the matching attendee. The final a11y run reported 221 passed, 0 failures, 1 expected TODO. [Task 1]
